### 0.1.0 (ci-build)

- The code of Onesa is now XXU (was XXK), the DEV test participant SMART Trust's Participants-DEV names "Onesa" (WorldHealthOrganization/smart-trust#161): the country definition, the identifiers of Onesa, schedule codes (`XXU-EPI-…`), lot numbers, the national portal, processes, device screens, examples and translations.
- First L2 and L3 content: generic personas and system actors as `ActorDefinition`s, user scenarios, and the business processes J1 to J4.1, generated from the harness sources.
- The journeys tell the [VaxLink](https://fredhersch.github.io/vaxlink/) story (issue [#21](https://github.com/litlfred/smart-trust-demo/issues/21)): Somsak SENGMANY, born in Taifafeki (XXR), living in Onesa (XXK), seen again in Taifafeki a year later. Personas, system actors and stories recast; the business processes made generic (no person names in them).
- New process steps: J2 adds the newborn to the household and saves the doses as reported, not verified; J3 adds the national schedule code beside the foreign vaccine code (the nurse decides unmapped products); J4.0 records the holder's consent with a passcode and an expiry; J4.1 adds the home portal's lane, which checks the passcode, returns the manifest and logs every access.
- New examples: household `Group`, registration `Questionnaire` and response, reported and verified `Immunization`s, verification and adjudication `Provenance`, `ConceptMap` from product to schedule code, an illustrative schedule `PlanDefinition`, `ImmunizationRecommendation` and reminder `Task`, the four doses given in Onesa, a six-dose IPS, `Consent`, and two `AuditEvent`s (access granted, wrong passcode). Two illustrative code systems stand in for PreQual product ids and national schedule codes.
- New terminology: `TrustDemoTrustDomain` and the `TrustDemoTrustDomains` ValueSet, the demo's own illustrative trust domains (DVC for J1 and J3, VHL for J4.0 and J4.1), in the style of the GDHCN Trust Domains of SMART Trust but not GDHCN codes.
- The DEMO-VHL trust domain's terms of use: `TrustDemoVhlConsent` and the `TrustDemoVhlTermsOfUse` ValueSet. The J4.0 consent is now a Personal Health Wallet explicit consent (`PHWExplicitConsent`) that names `CONSENT-VHL-TREATMENT` in `policyRule`.
- New page: [Journey examples](journey-examples.html), mapping each walkthrough screen and payload to its example here.

### TD.DT.01 What does a scanned DVC become in the child's record?

From the result of reading one foreign DVC, decide whether its dose is recorded as verified, kept as reported and not verified, or not recorded from it at all.

- **Serves:** [J2 Discover and refer an unregistered infant in Country B](business-processes.html#j2-discover-and-refer-an-unregistered-infant-in-country-b): Read each DVC unverified (triage) (`Task_Read`); Add the infant; save doses as reported (`Task_Register`); [J3 Verify, import and schedule at the home clinic](business-processes.html#j3-verify-import-and-schedule-at-the-home-clinic): Verify each HCERT against the trust list (`Task_Verify`); Every DVC verified? (`Gateway_Verified`); Note the failure; decide doses by policy (`Task_Unverified`); Import the doses as FHIR Immunization resources (`Task_Import`)
- **Requirements:** [STT-VER-001](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-tools/viewers/requirements.html#stt-ver-001), [STT-VER-006](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-tools/viewers/requirements.html#stt-ver-006), [STT-VER-008](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-tools/viewers/requirements.html#stt-ver-008), [STT-VER-011](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-tools/viewers/requirements.html#stt-ver-011)
- **Data elements:** [TD.J3A.DE05](dictionary.html#tdj3a-dvc-verification-and-import) Verification result, [TD.J3A.DE07](dictionary.html#tdj3a-dvc-verification-and-import) Failure reason, [TD.J3A.DE09](dictionary.html#tdj3a-dvc-verification-and-import) Record outcome
- **In the examples:** [StructureDefinition TrustDemoOnesaReportedImmunization](StructureDefinition-TrustDemoOnesaReportedImmunization.html), [StructureDefinition TrustDemoOnesaDvcVerification](StructureDefinition-TrustDemoOnesaDvcVerification.html), [Provenance TrustDemoJ3Verification](Provenance-TrustDemoJ3Verification.html)
- **Computable form:** [PlanDefinition TrustDemoDT01](PlanDefinition-TrustDemoDT01.html); source [dvc-record-outcome.dmn](https://github.com/litlfred/smart-trust-demo/blob/main/processes/content/decisions/dvc-record-outcome.dmn), hit policy FIRST

| # | Verification result (`result`) | Failure reason (`failureReason`) | **Record outcome** (`outcome`) | **Action** (`action`) | Annotation |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `unverified` | any | `reported-unverified` | Save the dose as reported by the family (primarySource false, the caregiver as information source, a note that nothing is verified) and refer the child to the clinic for verification. | The CHW's triage read in J2 ([STT-VER-011](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-tools/viewers/requirements.html#stt-ver-011)): nothing is verified, so the dose is reported, never verified. Example Immunization TrustDemoJ2HepBReported. |
| 2 | `verified` | any | `verified` | Import the dose with primarySource true and a verification Provenance that names the signer's key and removes the reported dose it replaces; then map its vaccine code (TD.DT.02). | J3's yes path ([STT-VER-001](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-tools/viewers/requirements.html#stt-ver-001)): the dose is recorded from its primary source. Examples Immunization TrustDemoJ3HepB and Provenance TrustDemoJ3Verification. |
| 3 | `failed` | `KidNotFound` | `reported-unverified` | Keep the dose as reported; record the step and reason ([STT-VER-008](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-tools/viewers/requirements.html#stt-ver-008)); verify the DVC again after the next trust-list refresh. | The signer's certificate is not in the clinic's cached trust list ([STT-VER-006](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-tools/viewers/requirements.html#stt-ver-006)), for example a signer added after the last refresh: J3's no path "until the next refresh". |
| 4 | `failed` | one of `Expired`, `NotYetValid` | `reported-unverified` | Keep the dose as reported; record the step and reason; the clinician decides by national policy whether to give or repeat the dose. | The signature verified, but the certificate is outside its validity period. The dose is not verified; the clinician decides by national policy. |
| 5 | `failed` | one of `BadPrefix`, `UnsupportedContextVersion`, `Base45Invalid`, `InflateFailed`, `LimitExceeded`, `CoseMalformed` | `not-read` | Scan again; if it still fails, treat the card as paper and record why it was not verified. | Decoding failed before any signature check ([STT-VER-001](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-tools/viewers/requirements.html#stt-ver-001) order), so nothing was read: three states, not two, since a bad scan is not evidence either way. |
| 6 | `failed` | any | `rejected` | Do not record a dose from this certificate; record the step and reason; the clinician decides by national policy, as for an undocumented dose. | Any other failure (signature, key usage, header, algorithm, hcert claim or payload): the certificate is not evidence of a dose. |
{: .grid }

  • Computable form: PlanDefinition TrustDemoDT01; source dvc-record-outcome.dmn, hit policy FIRST
# Verification result (result) Failure reason (failureReason) Record outcome (outcome) Action (action) Annotation
1 unverified any reported-unverified Save the dose as reported by the family (primarySource false, the caregiver as information source, a note that nothing is verified) and refer the child to the clinic for verification. The CHW's triage read in J2 (STT-VER-011): nothing is verified, so the dose is reported, never verified. Example Immunization TrustDemoJ2HepBReported.
2 verified any verified Import the dose with primarySource true and a verification Provenance that names the signer's key and removes the reported dose it replaces; then map its vaccine code (TD.DT.02). J3's yes path (STT-VER-001): the dose is recorded from its primary source. Examples Immunization TrustDemoJ3HepB and Provenance TrustDemoJ3Verification.
3 failed KidNotFound reported-unverified Keep the dose as reported; record the step and reason (STT-VER-008); verify the DVC again after the next trust-list refresh. The signer's certificate is not in the clinic's cached trust list (STT-VER-006), for example a signer added after the last refresh: J3's no path "until the next refresh".
4 failed one of Expired, NotYetValid reported-unverified Keep the dose as reported; record the step and reason; the clinician decides by national policy whether to give or repeat the dose. The signature verified, but the certificate is outside its validity period. The dose is not verified; the clinician decides by national policy.
5 failed one of BadPrefix, UnsupportedContextVersion, Base45Invalid, InflateFailed, LimitExceeded, CoseMalformed not-read Scan again; if it still fails, treat the card as paper and record why it was not verified. Decoding failed before any signature check (STT-VER-001 order), so nothing was read: three states, not two, since a bad scan is not evidence either way.
6 failed any rejected Do not record a dose from this certificate; record the step and reason; the clinician decides by national policy, as for an undocumented dose. Any other failure (signature, key usage, header, algorithm, hcert claim or payload): the certificate is not evidence of a dose.

### TD.DT.02 Which national schedule code does an imported dose carry?

For one dose, decide whether and how the national schedule code is added beside the issuer's product code, which is always kept.

- **Serves:** [J3 Verify, import and schedule at the home clinic](business-processes.html#j3-verify-import-and-schedule-at-the-home-clinic): Add national codes beside foreign ones (`Task_Map`)
- **Requirements:** [STD-SEM-001](https://github.com/litlfred/smart-trust-demo/blob/main/skills/requirements/std-sem-001.json)
- **Data elements:** [TD.J3A.DE09](dictionary.html#tdj3a-dvc-verification-and-import) Record outcome, [TD.J3B.DE01](dictionary.html#tdj3b-imported-dose-and-schedule) Issuer's product code, [TD.J3B.DE02](dictionary.html#tdj3b-imported-dose-and-schedule) National schedule code, [TD.J3B.DE03](dictionary.html#tdj3b-imported-dose-and-schedule) Mapping basis
- **In the examples:** [ConceptMap TrustDemoProductToOnesaEpi](ConceptMap-TrustDemoProductToOnesaEpi.html), [Provenance TrustDemoJ3Adjudication](Provenance-TrustDemoJ3Adjudication.html), [Immunization TrustDemoJ3HepB](Immunization-TrustDemoJ3HepB.html)
- **Computable form:** [PlanDefinition TrustDemoDT02](PlanDefinition-TrustDemoDT02.html); source [vaccine-code-mapping.dmn](https://github.com/litlfred/smart-trust-demo/blob/main/processes/content/decisions/vaccine-code-mapping.dmn), hit policy FIRST

| # | Record outcome (TD.DT.01) (`outcome`) | Entry in the national map (`mapEntry`) | Clinician confirms an equivalent (`clinicianConfirms`) | **Mapping basis** (`mappingBasis`) | **Action** (`action`) | Annotation |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | one of `reported-unverified`, `rejected`, `not-read` | any | any | `not-imported` | No schedule code is added. | Only a verified dose is imported and mapped (J3's yes path); a reported dose keeps the issuer's code alone. |
| 2 | `verified` | `equivalent` | any | `concept-map` | Add the mapped schedule code beside the product code. | [STD-SEM-001](https://github.com/litlfred/smart-trust-demo/blob/main/skills/requirements/std-sem-001.json) (map): the published national map has an equivalent; both codings are kept, as in TrustDemoJ3Bcg. |
| 3 | `verified` | `none` | `yes` | `clinician-confirmed` | Add the confirmed schedule code beside the product code; record the clinician's attestation as a Provenance; add the pair to the national map. | The map has no entry and the clinician confirms the equivalent (J3: the Hep B product). Her decision is recorded and added to the map so the next clinic need not repeat it. |
| 4 | `verified` | `none` | `no` | `unmapped` | Keep the product code as it is and show the dose to the clinician as unmapped; the schedule does not count it (TD.DT.03). | [STD-SEM-001](https://github.com/litlfred/smart-trust-demo/blob/main/skills/requirements/std-sem-001.json) (unmapped): no equivalent is known, and none is guessed. |
{: .grid }

TD.DT.02 Which national schedule code does an imported dose carry?

### TD.DT.03 Does the national schedule count this dose?

For one Immunization in the child's record, decide whether the schedule evaluation counts it as given.

- **Serves:** [J3 Verify, import and schedule at the home clinic](business-processes.html#j3-verify-import-and-schedule-at-the-home-clinic): Evaluate the national schedule (`Task_Schedule`)
- **Requirements:** [STD-SCH-001](https://github.com/litlfred/smart-trust-demo/blob/main/skills/requirements/std-sch-001.json), [STD-SEM-001](https://github.com/litlfred/smart-trust-demo/blob/main/skills/requirements/std-sem-001.json)

| 1 | `true` | any | `complete` | — | J3: the Hep B and BCG birth doses count once imported, so they are not recommended again ([STD-SCH-001](https://github.com/litlfred/smart-trust-demo/blob/main/skills/requirements/std-sch-001.json)). |

The data dictionary lists the data each journey records or exchanges, as the [WHO SMART Guidelines DAK](https://smart.who.int/ig-starter-kit/l2_dak.html) does in its component 5. **This demonstrator defines no data model of its own**: it shows how the existing specifications are used, so each data set is a model one of them already publishes. J1 signs the DVC payload of WHO SMART Trust PHW (`DVCMinPreQual`) into the CBOR Web Token of WHO SMART Trust (`CWT`); J2 registers the child with the client record of the WHO Immunization guide (`IMMZC4`, which is also its update of client details); J3 imports each verified dose as that guide's Immunization profile (`IMMZImmunization`); and J4 generates one IHE Verifiable Health Link payload (`VHLPayload`) per QR code. Each element is named `.` and is listed as its own specification defines it; that specification is the authority, and only the elements the journeys use are shown. "Realised in" says where this guide's profiles and examples carry the element. The elements are read by the [decision-support logic](decision-logic.html) and counted by the [indicators](indicators.html). head.html:
The data dictionary lists the data each journey records or exchanges, as the WHO SMART Guidelines DAK does in its component 5. This demonstrator defines no data model of its own: it shows how the existing specifications are used, so each data set is a model one of them already publishes. J1 signs the DVC payload of WHO SMART Trust PHW (DVCMinPreQual) into the CBOR Web Token of WHO SMART Trust (CWT); J2 registers the child with the client record of the WHO Immunization guide (IMMZC4, which is also its update of client details); J3 imports each verified dose as that guide's Immunization profile (IMMZImmunization); and J4 generates one IHE Verifiable Health Link payload (VHLPayload) per QR code.

Each element is named <model>.<path> and is listed as its own specification defines it; that specification is the authority, and only the elements the journeys use are shown. "Realised in" says where this guide's profiles and examples carry the element. The elements are read by the decision-support logic and counted by the indicators.

The source is dak/data-dictionary.json; this page and the code lists are generated from it. Every person and value in the examples is fictional.

### J1 CWT CBOR Web Token (CWT)

The CBOR Web Token of WHO SMART Trust that carries a DVC payload: the COSE header that names the signing key, the CWT claims and the signature. J1 signs one per dose with Taifafeki's key; J3 checks each against the trust list.

- **Logical model:** [CWT](http://smart.who.int/trust/StructureDefinition-CWT.html), canonical `http://smart.who.int/trust/StructureDefinition/CWT`
- **Specification:** [WHO SMART Trust](http://smart.who.int/trust), package `smart.who.int.trust` (1.5.0)
- **Recorded or read in:** [J1 Issue the newborn's birth-dose DVCs in Country A](business-processes.html#j1-issue-the-newborns-birth-dose-dvcs-in-country-a): Prepare: CWT claims and the COSE Sig_structure (`Task_Prepare`); Sign the bytes with XXR's DSC key (`Task_Sign`); [J3 Verify, import and schedule at the home clinic](business-processes.html#j3-verify-import-and-schedule-at-the-home-clinic): Verify each HCERT against the trust list (`Task_Verify`); Every DVC verified? (`Gateway_Verified`); Note the failure; decide doses by policy (`Task_Unverified`)
- **Requirements:** [STT-CWT-001](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-tools/viewers/requirements.html#stt-cwt-001), [STT-VER-001](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-tools/viewers/requirements.html#stt-ver-001), [STT-VER-006](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-tools/viewers/requirements.html#stt-ver-006), [STT-VER-008](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-tools/viewers/requirements.html#stt-ver-008)

J2 saves each dose read from a foreign card with it as reported (primarySource false); J3 imports each verified dose with it (primarySource true), adds the national code beside the product code and counts it toward the schedule.

- **Profile:** [IMMZImmunization](http://smart.who.int/immunizations/StructureDefinition-IMMZ.Immunization.html), canonical `http://smart.who.int/immunizations/StructureDefinition/IMMZ.Immunization`
- **Specification:** [WHO Immunization Implementation Guide](http://smart.who.int/immunizations), package `smart.who.int.immunizations` (1.0.0)
- **Recorded or read in:** [J2 Discover and refer an unregistered infant in Country B](business-processes.html#j2-discover-and-refer-an-unregistered-infant-in-country-b): Add the infant; save doses as reported (`Task_Register`); [J3 Verify, import and schedule at the home clinic](business-processes.html#j3-verify-import-and-schedule-at-the-home-clinic): Import the doses as FHIR Immunization resources (`Task_Import`); Add national codes beside foreign ones (`Task_Map`); Evaluate the national schedule (`Task_Schedule`); Give due doses and book the next visit (`Task_Plan`)
- **Requirements:** [STT-VER-006](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-tools/viewers/requirements.html#stt-ver-006), [STD-SEM-001](https://github.com/litlfred/smart-trust-demo/blob/main/skills/requirements/std-sem-001.json), [STD-SCH-001](https://github.com/litlfred/smart-trust-demo/blob/main/skills/requirements/std-sch-001.json)

### J4 VHLPayload VHL Payload

The payload of a Verifiable Health Link (IHE ITI VHL), carried at HCERT claim key 5. J4.0 generates one per QR code, one for each family member; J4.1 reads it from the QR and requests the manifest it points to.

- **Logical model:** [VHLPayload](https://build.fhir.org/ig/IHE/ITI.VHL/branches/jul26/StructureDefinition-VHLPayload.html), canonical `https://profiles.ihe.net/ITI/VHL/StructureDefinition/VHLPayload`
- **Specification:** [IHE ITI Verifiable Health Links (VHL)](https://build.fhir.org/ig/IHE/ITI.VHL/branches/jul26), package `ihe.iti.vhl` (ci build, branch jul26 (not yet released))
- **Recorded or read in:** [J4.0 Issue the family's records to one phone as VHLs](business-processes.html#j40-issue-the-familys-records-to-one-phone-as-vhls): Choose who to share, with a passcode and an expiry (`Task_Request`); Encrypt, publish a passcode manifest (`Task_Share`); Prepare the HCERT carrying the VHL at key 5 (`Task_Prepare`); [J4.1 Read a family member's records at the point of care abroad](business-processes.html#j41-read-a-family-members-records-at-the-point-of-care-abroad): Verify the HCERT and read the VHL at key 5 (`Task_Verify`); Request the manifest (ITI-YY5), signed (`Task_Fetch`); Check passcode, log access, return manifest (`Task_Release`)
- **Requirements:** [STD-ACC-001](https://github.com/litlfred/smart-trust-demo/blob/main/skills/requirements/std-acc-001.json), [STT-VHL-005](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-tools/viewers/requirements.html#stt-vhl-005), [STT-VHL-009](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-tools/viewers/requirements.html#stt-vhl-009)
- **Realised by:** [Bundle TrustDemoJ4Ips](Bundle-TrustDemoJ4Ips.html), [Consent TrustDemoJ4Consent](Consent-TrustDemoJ4Consent.html), [StructureDefinition TrustDemoOnesaVhlAccess](StructureDefinition-TrustDemoOnesaVhlAccess.html)

| Element | Label | Card. | Type | Definition | Binding | Realised in |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `VHLPayload.url` | Manifest URL | 1..1 | url | The manifest URL, a FHIR search on the List folder that holds this member's documents. |  | the folder of Bundle TrustDemoJ4Ips |
| `VHLPayload.key` | Decryption key | 1..1 | string | The 32-byte key, base64url, that decrypts the documents the manifest returns. |  | not realised in the examples |
| `VHLPayload.exp` | Expires at | 0..1 | decimal | When the link stops working: the end of the period the holder chose. |  | TrustDemoJ4Consent: Consent.provision.period.end |
| `VHLPayload.flag` | Flags | 0..1 | string | L (long-term) and P (a passcode is required); J4's links carry P. |  | the passcode the holder set |
| `VHLPayload.label` | Label | 0..1 | string | A short description of what the link shares, for example the member's name. |  | not realised in the examples |
| `VHLPayload.v` | Version | 0..1 | integer | The protocol version. |  | not realised in the examples |
| `VHLPayload.extension` | Extensions | 0..1 | BackboneElement | Implementation-defined extensions. |  | not realised in the examples |
| `VHLPayload.extension.fhirBaseUrl` | VHL Sharer FHIR base URL | 0..1 | string | Where the receiver performs UDAP discovery before a signed manifest request (ITI-YY5). |  | not realised in the examples |

### What the examples change from the walkthrough's copies

- **Code systems.** The walkthrough's product codes (`vp-hepb-peds-monovalent` and so on) and the schedule codes of Onesa (`XXU-EPI-HEPB-BD` and so on) are illustrative. They are defined here as the code systems `TrustDemoVaccineProduct` and `TrustDemoOnesaEpiSchedule`, marked experimental, under this guide's canonical, so no URL implies a real ministry or a real WHO code system.
- **Countries.** Taifafeki is played on the GDHCN DEV network by test participant XXR and Onesa by the fictional XXU. Neither is a production key.
- **The passcode.** The walkthrough shows `4829` on screen. No example stores a passcode: the consent and audit records say only that one was checked.
- **Dates.** As in the walkthrough: birth 2025-10-28, J2 2025-11-18, J3 2025-11-25, the doses in Onesa 2025-12-10 and 2026-07-28, the trip 2026-10-28.

                  id="Definitions_Process_J2ChwDiscovery" targetNamespace="https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-trust-demo/processes" exporter="smart-trust-demo" exporterVersion="1">
  <bpmn:resource id="caregiver" name="Caregiver"/>
  <bpmn:resource id="community-health-worker" name="Community health worker"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Process_J2ChwDiscovery">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Process_J2ChwDiscovery" name="J2 Discover and refer an unregistered infant in Country B" processRef="Process_J2ChwDiscovery"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_J2ChwDiscovery" name="J2 Discover and refer an unregistered infant in Country B" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>J2, Return home, CHW discovery and referral. Back in Country B (home, XXU), where the family resides, the community health worker finds an infant born abroad who is missing from the household roster on a home visit. Offline, the CHW app adds the infant to the household (a FHIR Group, through a structured data capture form), reads the foreign DVCs without verifying them (read-unverified, STT-VER-011: the triage read stops before the trust lookup and marks every field unverified), saves the doses as reported by the family, not verified (Immunization.primarySource false), and refers the infant to the clinic for verification. Everything is queued on the phone and syncs when it next has a signal. The CHW app is a Receiver (SMART Trust, smart-trust-phw) that deliberately stops before trust; the caregiver provides the VDHC as Holder (smart-trust-phw requirement provide-a-vhl-to-a-receiver).</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:extensionElements><cat-harness.processes:policy enforcement="advisory"/><cat-harness.processes:log capture="off"/></bpmn:extensionElements>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Process_J2ChwDiscovery">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_caregiver" name="Caregiver" partitionElementRef="caregiver">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Show</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_community-health-worker" name="Community health worker" partitionElementRef="community-health-worker">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Scan</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Slip</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_chw-app" name="CHW app" partitionElementRef="chw-app">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Read</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Register</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Refer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start" name="Home visit finds an unregistered infant"><bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing></bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Show" name="Show the paper DVCs from Country A"><bpmn:extensionElements><bootstrap.processes:skill ref="holder-present-credential"/></bpmn:extensionElements><bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming><bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing></bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Scan" name="Scan each QR with the CHW app"><bpmn:extensionElements><bootstrap.processes:skill ref="receiver-scan-credential"/></bpmn:extensionElements><bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming><bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing></bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_Read" name="Read each DVC unverified (triage)"><bpmn:documentation>read-unverified (STT-VER-011): strip HC1:, Base45, inflate within limits (STT-B45-002, STT-ZIP-002), bounded CBOR (STT-CBR-003), payloads read but flagged unverified; no trust list needed, fully offline.</bpmn:documentation><bpmn:extensionElements><bootstrap.processes:skill ref="hcert-verify"/></bpmn:extensionElements><bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming><bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing></bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="Task_Register" name="Add the infant; save doses as reported" calledElement="Process_QuestionnaireDataCapture"><bpmn:documentation>Add the infant to the household; save the doses as reported, not verified. The CHW completes the newborn registration form (data dictionary TD.J2A) in the CHW app through smart-base's reusable SDC data-capture process: complete-sdc-questionnaire, then extract-questionnaire-response. chw-register-infant is what this journey's extraction writes: the Patient and the caregiver's RelatedPerson, and each dose read by the triage read as an Immunization tagged unverified.</bpmn:documentation><bpmn:extensionElements><bootstrap.processes:skill ref="chw-register-infant"/></bpmn:extensionElements><bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming><bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing></bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_Refer" name="Create a referral to the home clinic for verification"><bpmn:extensionElements><bootstrap.processes:skill ref="chw-refer"/></bpmn:extensionElements><bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming><bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing></bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Slip" name="Explain the referral to the family"><bpmn:extensionElements><bootstrap.processes:skill ref="inform-client"/></bpmn:extensionElements><bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming><bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing></bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End" name="Family has a referral; the record syncs when online"><bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming></bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="Start" targetRef="Task_Show"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_Show" targetRef="Task_Scan"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_Scan" targetRef="Task_Read"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_Read" targetRef="Task_Register"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_Register" targetRef="Task_Refer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_Refer" targetRef="Task_Slip"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_Slip" targetRef="End"/>
  </bpmn:process>

    <bpmn:documentation>J2, Return home, CHW discovery and referral. Back in Country B (home, XXU), where the family resides, the community health worker finds an infant born abroad who is missing from the household roster on a home visit. Offline, the CHW app adds the infant to the household (a FHIR Group, through a structured data capture form), reads the foreign DVCs without verifying them (read-unverified, STT-VER-011: the triage read stops before the trust lookup and marks every field unverified), saves the doses as reported by the family, not verified (Immunization.primarySource false), and refers the infant to the clinic for verification. Everything is queued on the phone and syncs when it next has a signal. The CHW app is a Receiver (SMART Trust, smart-trust-phw) that deliberately stops before trust; the caregiver provides the VDHC as Holder (smart-trust-phw requirement provide-a-vhl-to-a-receiver).</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:extensionElements><cat-harness.processes:policy enforcement="advisory"/><cat-harness.processes:log capture="off"/></bpmn:extensionElements>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Slip</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_chw-app" name="CHW app" partitionElementRef="chw-app">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Read</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Register</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Refer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start" name="Home visit finds an unregistered infant"><bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing></bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Show" name="Show the paper DVCs from Country A"><bpmn:extensionElements><bootstrap.processes:skill ref="holder-present-credential"/></bpmn:extensionElements><bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming><bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing></bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Scan" name="Scan each QR with the CHW app"><bpmn:extensionElements><bootstrap.processes:skill ref="receiver-scan-credential"/></bpmn:extensionElements><bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming><bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing></bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_Read" name="Read each DVC unverified (triage)"><bpmn:documentation>read-unverified (STT-VER-011): strip HC1:, Base45, inflate within limits (STT-B45-002, STT-ZIP-002), bounded CBOR (STT-CBR-003), payloads read but flagged unverified; no trust list needed, fully offline.</bpmn:documentation><bpmn:extensionElements><bootstrap.processes:skill ref="hcert-verify"/></bpmn:extensionElements><bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming><bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing></bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="Task_Register" name="Add the infant; save doses as reported" calledElement="Process_QuestionnaireDataCapture"><bpmn:documentation>Add the infant to the household; save the doses as reported, not verified. The CHW completes the newborn registration form (data dictionary TD.J2A) in the CHW app through smart-base's reusable SDC data-capture process: complete-sdc-questionnaire, then extract-questionnaire-response. chw-register-infant is what this journey's extraction writes: the Patient and the caregiver's RelatedPerson, and each dose read by the triage read as an Immunization tagged unverified.</bpmn:documentation><bpmn:extensionElements><bootstrap.processes:skill ref="chw-register-infant"/></bpmn:extensionElements><bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming><bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing></bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_Refer" name="Create a referral to the home clinic for verification"><bpmn:extensionElements><bootstrap.processes:skill ref="chw-refer"/></bpmn:extensionElements><bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming><bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing></bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Slip" name="Explain the referral to the family"><bpmn:extensionElements><bootstrap.processes:skill ref="inform-client"/></bpmn:extensionElements><bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming><bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing></bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End" name="Family has a referral; the record syncs when online"><bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming></bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="Start" targetRef="Task_Show"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_Show" targetRef="Task_Scan"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_Scan" targetRef="Task_Read"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_Read" targetRef="Task_Register"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_Register" targetRef="Task_Refer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_Refer" targetRef="Task_Slip"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_Slip" targetRef="End"/>
  </bpmn:process>

                  id="Definitions_Process_J2ChwDiscovery" targetNamespace="https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-trust-demo/processes" exporter="smart-trust-demo" exporterVersion="1">
  <bpmn:resource id="caregiver" name="Caregiver"/>
  <bpmn:resource id="community-health-worker" name="Community health worker"/>
  <bpmn:resource id="chw-app" name="CHW app"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Process_J2ChwDiscovery">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Process_J2ChwDiscovery" name="J2 Discover and refer an unregistered infant in Country B" processRef="Process_J2ChwDiscovery"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_J2ChwDiscovery" name="J2 Discover and refer an unregistered infant in Country B" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>J2, Return home, CHW discovery and referral. Back in Country B (home, XXU), where the family resides, the community health worker finds an infant born abroad who is missing from the household roster on a home visit. Offline, the CHW app adds the infant to the household (a FHIR Group, through a structured data capture form), reads the foreign DVCs without verifying them (read-unverified, STT-VER-011: the triage read stops before the trust lookup and marks every field unverified), saves the doses as reported by the family, not verified (Immunization.primarySource false), and refers the infant to the clinic for verification. Everything is queued on the phone and syncs when it next has a signal. The CHW app is a Receiver (SMART Trust, smart-trust-phw) that deliberately stops before trust; the caregiver provides the VDHC as Holder (smart-trust-phw requirement provide-a-vhl-to-a-receiver).</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:extensionElements><cat-harness.processes:policy enforcement="advisory"/><cat-harness.processes:log capture="off"/></bpmn:extensionElements>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Process_J2ChwDiscovery">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_caregiver" name="Caregiver" partitionElementRef="caregiver">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Show</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_community-health-worker" name="Community health worker" partitionElementRef="community-health-worker">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Scan</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Slip</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_chw-app" name="CHW app" partitionElementRef="chw-app">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Read</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Register</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Refer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start" name="Home visit finds an unregistered infant"><bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing></bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Show" name="Show the paper DVCs from Country A"><bpmn:extensionElements><bootstrap.processes:skill ref="holder-present-credential"/></bpmn:extensionElements><bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming><bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing></bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Scan" name="Scan each QR with the CHW app"><bpmn:extensionElements><bootstrap.processes:skill ref="receiver-scan-credential"/></bpmn:extensionElements><bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming><bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing></bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_Read" name="Read each DVC unverified (triage)"><bpmn:documentation>read-unverified (STT-VER-011): strip HC1:, Base45, inflate within limits (STT-B45-002, STT-ZIP-002), bounded CBOR (STT-CBR-003), payloads read but flagged unverified; no trust list needed, fully offline.</bpmn:documentation><bpmn:extensionElements><bootstrap.processes:skill ref="hcert-verify"/></bpmn:extensionElements><bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming><bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing></bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="Task_Register" name="Add the infant; save doses as reported" calledElement="Process_QuestionnaireDataCapture"><bpmn:documentation>Add the infant to the household; save the doses as reported, not verified. The CHW completes the newborn registration form (the client record IMMZ.C4 of the WHO Immunization guide, data dictionary IMMZC4) in the CHW app through smart-base's reusable SDC data-capture process: complete-sdc-questionnaire, then extract-questionnaire-response. chw-register-infant is what this journey's extraction writes: the Patient and the caregiver's RelatedPerson, and each dose read by the triage read as an Immunization tagged unverified.</bpmn:documentation><bpmn:extensionElements><bootstrap.processes:skill ref="chw-register-infant"/></bpmn:extensionElements><bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming><bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing></bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_Refer" name="Create a referral to the home clinic for verification"><bpmn:extensionElements><bootstrap.processes:skill ref="chw-refer"/></bpmn:extensionElements><bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming><bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing></bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Slip" name="Explain the referral to the family"><bpmn:extensionElements><bootstrap.processes:skill ref="inform-client"/></bpmn:extensionElements><bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming><bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing></bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End" name="Family has a referral; the record syncs when online"><bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming></bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="Start" targetRef="Task_Show"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_Show" targetRef="Task_Scan"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_Scan" targetRef="Task_Read"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_Read" targetRef="Task_Register"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_Register" targetRef="Task_Refer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_Refer" targetRef="Task_Slip"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_Slip" targetRef="End"/>

* description = """
The hospital system abroad that issues a DVC per dose with the HCERT library: the HCERT issuing system (smart-trust-tools) of a trust network participant (XXR).

**Persona**: Software that calls the library once per dose and never holds the private key; signs only with a DSC its country's CSCA issued and has already shared with the GDHCN.

**Also known as**: Issuer of the birth-dose DVCs (SMART Trust Issuer)

**Played in the journeys by** (fictional):

- Kesaro Provincial Hospital system, Taifafeki (Country A, XXR)

**In the user scenarios**:

- [J1 — Vaccinated and recorded](scenarios.html#j1--vaccinated-and-recorded-taifafeki-birth-day): J1 A baby from Onesa is born in Taifafeki

**On the device screens**: [S1 Birth Abroad & Printed DVC QR Cards (Dr. Anan's tablet)](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/demo/S1/)

**Discussed in the workshop modules**: [M1 From journey to capabilities](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/m1/); [M4 Trust, credentials and wallets](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/m4/); [M5 Governance, decision rights and the legal basis](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/m5/); [T1 Building with FHIR and the Open Health Stack](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/technical-track/t1/); [T3 Trust between countries: SMART Trust and the GDHCN](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/technical-track/t3/)

**Lanes and tasks in the business processes**:

- [J1 Issue the newborn's birth-dose DVCs in Country A](business-processes.html#j1-issue-the-newborns-birth-dose-dvcs-in-country-a): Build one DVCMinPreQual payload per dose; Prepare: CWT claims and the COSE Sig_structure; Finish: COSE_Sign1, deflate, Base45, HC1:

**Data sets its tasks record or read**: [TD.J1 Birth-dose DVC](dictionary.html#tdj1-birth-dose-dvc)
"""

* derivedFrom[+] = "http://smart.who.int/trust-phw/ActorDefinition/Issuer"

* type = #system
* description = """
The clinic's OHS-based record system: verifies DVCs against the GDHCN trust list, imports them as FHIR Immunization resources and evaluates the national schedule (J3).

**Persona**: Holds the DID trust list from its last refresh, about weekly for a clinic without its own connection, when the CHW visits the base clinic or district health office; loading it is a precondition of a visit, and it verifies offline at the point of care.

**Also known as**: Verifier at the home clinic (SMART Trust Receiver)

**Played in the journeys by** (fictional):

- Lomaru District Health Center EHR (Country B)

- [J3 — A foreign record used for the next vaccine](scenarios.html#j3--a-foreign-record-used-for-the-next-vaccine-lomaru-district-health-center-somsak-is-10-weeks-old): J3a The clinic confirms the cards are genuine; J3b Taifafeki vaccines are fitted to the Onesa schedule

**Lanes and tasks in the business processes**:

* description = """
The nurse at the home clinic who receives the referral, has the foreign DVCs verified and decides catch-up doses (J3).

**Persona**: Trusts the system's verdict and needs a reason when a certificate fails.

**Played in the journeys by** (fictional):

* ^experimental = true

base.prose:
// J3a and J3b, Lomaru District Health Center, Onesa, 2026-01-06 (T0 + 10
// weeks). Nurse Chanthason scans the DVCs; the EHR verifies each against its
// cached GDHCN DEV trust list (XXR's DSC, kid 916ffa567c0f44a2), offline, and
// imports the doses with provenance. The issuer's product coding is kept and
// the national schedule coding is added beside it (ConceptMap; the nurse
// confirms the Hep B product, which had no mapping). The schedule then finds
// the 6-week doses overdue: they are given that day (catch-up), and the
// reminder is for the next doses, 4 weeks later.

Instance: TrustDemoJ3HepB
InstanceOf: TrustDemoOnesaImmunization
Title: "J3 verified: Hep B birth dose (Taifafeki), with both codings"
Description: "The Hep B birth dose after the EHR verified its DVC: the verified DVC is the administering hospital's own signed record, so the dose is recorded from its primary source (the VaxLink trust ladder's 'verified' step). The issuer's product coding is kept, and the national schedule coding is added beside it."
Usage: #example
* status = #completed
* vaccineCode.coding[product] = TrustDemoVaccineProduct#vp-hepb-peds-monovalent "Hepatitis B vaccine, paediatric, monovalent"
* vaccineCode.coding[onesaEpi] = TrustDemoOnesaEpiSchedule#XXU-EPI-HEPB-BD "Hepatitis B birth dose"
* vaccineCode.coding[cvx] = $cvx#08 "Hep B, adolescent or pediatric"
* vaccineCode.text = "Hepatitis B paediatric birth dose"
* patient = Reference(TrustDemoSomsak)
* occurrenceDateTime = "2025-10-28T09:15:00+07:00"
* primarySource = true
* performer.actor = Reference(TrustDemoAnan)
* lotNumber = "XXR-4821"
* location.display = "Kesaro Provincial Hospital, Taifafeki"
* protocolApplied.doseNumberPositiveInt = 1

InstanceOf: TrustDemoOnesaImmunization

* vaccineCode.coding[cvx] = $cvx#19 "BCG"
* vaccineCode.text = "BCG"
* patient = Reference(TrustDemoSomsak)

* primarySource = true

* location.display = "Kesaro Provincial Hospital, Taifafeki"

Instance: TrustDemoJ3Verification
InstanceOf: TrustDemoOnesaDvcVerification
Title: "J3a provenance: DVCs verified against the GDHCN DEV trust list"
Description: "Records that the two doses come from DVCs the district EHR verified offline (COSE_Sign1, ES256) against XXR's DSC in its cached copy of the GDHCN DEV trust list, and that they replace the reported doses of J2."
Usage: #example
* target[+] = Reference(TrustDemoJ3HepB)
* target[+] = Reference(TrustDemoJ3Bcg)
* recorded = "2026-01-06T10:14:22+07:00"
* policy = "http://smart.who.int/trust"
* activity.text = "Verified each DVC (HCERT) offline against the cached GDHCN DEV trust list, then imported it"
* agent[+].type = http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/provenance-participant-type#verifier "Verifier"
* agent[=].who = Reference(TrustDemoDhcEhr)
* agent[+].type = http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/provenance-participant-type#enterer "Enterer"
* agent[=].who = Reference(TrustDemoChanthason)
* agent[+].type = http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/provenance-participant-type#author "Author"
* agent[=].who = Reference(TrustDemoKesaroHospital)
* entity[+].role = #source
* entity[=].what.display = "DVC (HCERT, HC1 QR) for the Hep B birth dose, signed by XXR, kid 916ffa567c0f44a2"
* entity[+].role = #source
* entity[=].what.display = "DVC (HCERT, HC1 QR) for the BCG birth dose, signed by XXR, kid 916ffa567c0f44a2"
* entity[+].role = #removal
* entity[=].what = Reference(TrustDemoJ2HepBReported)
* entity[+].role = #removal
* entity[=].what = Reference(TrustDemoJ2BcgReported)

Instance: TrustDemoJ3Adjudication
InstanceOf: Provenance
Title: "J3b provenance: the nurse's vaccine-code adjudication"
Description: "Records Nurse Chanthason's clinical call that the Taifafeki Hep B product counts as the national Hep B birth dose, which the map did not yet cover. The decision is added to the national ConceptMap for the next clinic."
Usage: #example
* target[+] = Reference(TrustDemoJ3HepB)
* target[+] = Reference(TrustDemoProductToOnesaEpi)
* recorded = "2026-01-06T10:21:00+07:00"
* activity.text = "Confirmed vp-hepb-peds-monovalent as equivalent to XXU-EPI-HEPB-BD; issuer coding kept, schedule coding added"
* agent[+].type = http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/provenance-participant-type#attester "Attester"
* agent[=].who = Reference(TrustDemoChanthason)

Instance: TrustDemoJ3Recommendation
InstanceOf: ImmunizationRecommendation
Title: "J3b schedule evaluation: the 6-week doses are overdue"
Description: "The national schedule run over the verified doses read by their schedule codes: the Hep B and BCG birth doses count, and pentavalent 1, bOPV 1 and PCV 1, due at 6 weeks (2025-12-09), are overdue at 10 weeks, so they are given that day."
Usage: #example
* patient = Reference(TrustDemoSomsak)
* date = "2026-01-06T10:22:00+07:00"
* authority = Reference(TrustDemoLomaruDhc)
* recommendation[+].vaccineCode = TrustDemoOnesaEpiSchedule#XXU-EPI-PENTA-1 "Pentavalent (DTP-HepB-Hib), dose 1"
* recommendation[=].forecastStatus = http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/immunization-recommendation-status#overdue "Overdue"
* recommendation[=].dateCriterion.code = $loinc#30980-7 "Date vaccine due"
* recommendation[=].dateCriterion.value = "2025-12-09"
* recommendation[=].supportingImmunization[+] = Reference(TrustDemoJ3HepB)
* recommendation[+].vaccineCode = TrustDemoOnesaEpiSchedule#XXU-EPI-OPV-1 "bOPV, dose 1"
* recommendation[=].forecastStatus = http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/immunization-recommendation-status#overdue "Overdue"
* recommendation[=].dateCriterion.code = $loinc#30980-7 "Date vaccine due"
* recommendation[=].dateCriterion.value = "2025-12-09"
* recommendation[+].vaccineCode = TrustDemoOnesaEpiSchedule#XXU-EPI-PCV-1 "PCV, dose 1"
* recommendation[=].forecastStatus = http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/immunization-recommendation-status#overdue "Overdue"
* recommendation[=].dateCriterion.code = $loinc#30980-7 "Date vaccine due"
* recommendation[=].dateCriterion.value = "2025-12-09"

// The vaccine codings of the journeys. Both code systems are illustrative
// stand-ins, as in the VaxLink walkthrough: TrustDemoVaccineProduct stands in
// for WHO PreQual product ids (the issuer's coding, as signed in a DVC) and
// TrustDemoOnesaEpiSchedule for a national schedule's antigen-and-dose codes.
// Neither is an official code system; real deployments use the WHO PreQual
// ids and the country's own schedule codes.

* ^caseSensitive = true

// The trust domains of the journeys. A GDHCN trust domain scopes what a
// participant's keys may sign; the DID trust list names it for each key, and a
// verifier accepts a certificate only under a domain it knows. These codes are
// the demo's own, invented for the Onesa and Taifafeki journeys, in the style
// of the GDHCN Trust Domains CodeSystem of smart-trust
// (http://smart.who.int/trust/CodeSystem/Domains-DEV). They are not GDHCN
// trust domains.

CodeSystem: TrustDemoTrustDomain
Id: TrustDemoTrustDomain
Title: "Trust domains of the journeys (illustrative)"
Description: "Illustrative GDHCN-style trust domains for the demo's journeys: the scope under which each certificate in J1 to J4.1 is signed and verified. Invented for the demo, modelled on the GDHCN Trust Domains of SMART Trust; not GDHCN trust domains."
* ^experimental = true
* ^caseSensitive = true
* #DEMO-DVC "Demo: Digital Vaccination Certificate" "Routine-immunization DVCs (HCERT) signed per dose by a birth clinic system and verified by a home clinic EHR (J1, J3)."
* #DEMO-VHL "Demo: Verifiable Health Link" "Verifiable Health Links (HCERT) to a patient summary, created on the national portal and resolved at a point of care abroad (J4.0, J4.1). Its terms of use are TrustDemoVhlTermsOfUse."

ValueSet: TrustDemoTrustDomains
Id: TrustDemoTrustDomains
Title: "Trust domains of the journeys"
Description: "Every code of TrustDemoTrustDomain: the trust domains a verifier in the journeys accepts."
* ^experimental = true
* include codes from system TrustDemoTrustDomain

// DEMO-VHL's terms of use: the consent codes a holder may agree to when a VHL
// is created. As in the Personal Health Wallet guide (PHWExplicitConsent), an
// explicit consent names the code, with the code system version whose text the
// holder was shown, in Consent.policyRule. Used by the J4.0 business process
// (the family creates the VHL and consents).

CodeSystem: TrustDemoVhlConsent
Id: TrustDemoVhlConsent
Title: "Consents of the demo VHL trust domain (illustrative)"
Description: "The consent codes of the illustrative DEMO-VHL trust domain: what a holder agrees to when the family wallet creates a Verifiable Health Link (J4.0). Invented for the demo, in the style of the IPS for Pilgrimage consents (IPS.HAJJ.CONSENT); not a GDHCN trust domain's terms of use."
* ^experimental = true
* ^caseSensitive = true
* #CONSENT-VHL-TREATMENT "Consent to read the summary for treatment" "Anyone the holder gives the VHL's QR code and passcode to may read the patient summary behind it, for treatment, until the link expires. Each access is logged by the issuing portal."

ValueSet: TrustDemoVhlTermsOfUse
Id: TrustDemoVhlTermsOfUse
Title: "Terms of use of the demo VHL trust domain"
Description: "The terms of use of the DEMO-VHL trust domain (TrustDemoTrustDomain): every code of TrustDemoVhlConsent. An explicit consent to share a VHL names one of them in Consent.policyRule (J4.0)."
* ^experimental = true
* include codes from system TrustDemoVhlConsent

* agent 2..* MS
* entity 1..* MS

Profile: TrustDemoOnesaVhlAccess
Parent: AuditEvent
Id: TrustDemoOnesaVhlAccess
Title: "Onesa: every VHL access logged at home"
Description: """

* requester 1..1 MS
* performer 1..* MS
* supportingInfo 1..* MS

Id: TrustDemoOnesaDvcVerification
Title: "Onesa: foreign DVC verified against the GDHCN trust list"
Description: """
How it is used: J3a. The district EHR verifies each Taifafeki DVC offline against its cached copy of the GDHCN trust list, then imports the dose. This record says so.

Why: a verified dose replaces a reported one, so the record must show who verified what, against which policy, and which reported doses it removes. Anyone who later doubts a dose can follow this record back to the signed certificate and the issuing country's key.

* target 1..* MS
* target only Reference(TrustDemoOnesaImmunization)
* policy 1..* MS
* activity 1..1 MS
* agent 2..* MS
* entity 1..* MS

Profile: TrustDemoOnesaVhlAccess
Parent: AuditEvent
Id: TrustDemoOnesaVhlAccess
Title: "Onesa: every VHL access logged at home"

How it is used: J4.1. The national gateway of Onesa records each attempt by a clinic abroad to fetch a family member's VHL manifest, the refused ones included.

Why: the family shares a link, not a copy, and the data stays in Onesa. Logging every access at home, following IHE Basic Audit Log Patterns, is what lets the family and the ministry see who looked, from where and when. A wrong passcode is logged too.
"""
* recorded MS
* outcome 1..1 MS
* agent 2..* MS
* source.observer MS
* entity 1..* MS

* primarySource = true

* protocolApplied 1..* MS
* protocolApplied.doseNumber[x] 1..1

Parent: Provenance
Id: TrustDemoTaifafekiVhlReceipt

Description: """

"""

### TD.J1 Birth-dose DVC

What the birth hospital records for each birth dose and signs into one Digital Vaccination Certificate (DVC, an HCERT) per dose: the payload, the CWT claims and the key that signs it.

- **Logical model:** [TrustDemoDdBirthDoseDvc](StructureDefinition-TrustDemoDdBirthDoseDvc.html)
- **Recorded or read in:** [J1 Issue the newborn's birth-dose DVCs in Country A](business-processes.html#j1-issue-the-newborns-birth-dose-dvcs-in-country-a): Build one DVCMinPreQual payload per dose (`Task_Payload`); Prepare: CWT claims and the COSE Sig_structure (`Task_Prepare`); Sign the bytes with XXR's DSC key (`Task_Sign`)
- **Requirements:** [STT-PAY-001](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-tools/viewers/requirements.html#stt-pay-001), [STT-PAY-002](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-tools/viewers/requirements.html#stt-pay-002), [STT-PAY-003](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-tools/viewers/requirements.html#stt-pay-003), [STT-PAY-005](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-tools/viewers/requirements.html#stt-pay-005), [STT-CWT-001](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-tools/viewers/requirements.html#stt-cwt-001)

### TD.J3A DVC verification and import

What the clinic records when it verifies a foreign DVC against its cached copy of the trust list, and, when the DVC verifies, imports the dose in place of the reported one.

- **Logical model:** [TrustDemoDdDvcVerification](StructureDefinition-TrustDemoDdDvcVerification.html)
